# deps: tools: up gojq to v0.12.9

Pin `gojq` (the pure-Go `jq` implementation kept in the Go toolset) at v0.12.9, following [[DOT-313]] (v0.12.8). The upgrade is a change of the pin in [toolset/go.mod](../../toolset/go.mod), installed via [tools.go](../../toolset/tools.go). The release notes are the [v0.12.9 tag](https://github.com/itchyny/gojq/releases/tag/v0.12.9).
